articleTitle: What to Say When You Learn About a Death Months Later
imageHeadline: It's Not Too Late to Say Something
imageSubtext: Supporting someone through grief, even months after their loss
pinTitle: How to Reach Out After Learning About a Death Late | Grief Support That Matters
pinDescription: Finding out about a friend's loss months later can feel awkward, but your support still matters. Learn what to say and how to offer meaningful care when the immediate grief window has passed and others may have moved on.
